title: Customs Tariff Act 1995
converter: cth_convert_sym_v4.py (a copy of docx_text() and the volume joining of the workbench converter tools/fetch/fetch-source.py that also maps Symbol-font, Wingdings and private-use characters, including the Symbol digits F030-F039; kept outside the repository); the first deposit used tools/fetch/fetch-source.py

reconverted_2026_11_07.previous_converter: tools/fetch/fetch-source.py (docx_text), the converter of the 2026-09-22 deposit
reconverted_2026_11_07.source_docx_note: the seven Word volumes C2026C00399VOL01-VOL07, joined in order; same compilation as the first deposit
reconverted_2026_11_07.why: docx_text() dropped every Word <w:sym> character, which is how the Register writes some characters in the Symbol and Wingdings fonts, and kept Symbol-font characters typed as text as raw private-use code points (U+F0xx), which display as empty boxes. cth_convert_sym.py maps them to Unicode (Symbol F0D7 ·, F0B4 ×, F02D −, F0B7 •, F0A3 ≤, F0B3 ≥, F0B0 ° and the like) and Wingdings boxes to "[ ]".
reconverted_2026_11_07.what_changed: Five degree signs (Symbol F0B0 °) restored, "20 C" -> "20 °C" and the like: Chapter 22 Note 2 (line 4940), Subheading Note 1 (line 4943) and Additional Note 2 (line 4946), each "20 °C"; Chapter 59 Note 2(a)(2) (line 16715), "between 15 °C and 30 °C". None of them was in C2004A04997.formulas.md. Reconverted from the same Word volumes (same download sha256); a diff against the first deposit shows no other change (same 76,562 lines; 5 characters added). Not changed: the subheading 6902.20.00 paragraph (line 19051) still reads "(AlO)" and "(SiO)", because its subscript digits are Symbol F032 and F033, which the converter does not map; C2004A04997.formulas.md gives that paragraph whole as "(Al2O3)" and "(SiO2)".
reconverted_2026_11_07.encodings_affected: none: baseline-2026-10 relies on none of the changed lines (Chapters 22 and 59 are not encoded, and no rule, case or finding cites them)

reconverted_2026_11_08.previous_converter: cth_convert_sym.py, the converter of the 2026-11-07 reconversion
reconverted_2026_11_08.source_docx_note: the same seven Word volumes C2026C00399VOL01-VOL07, joined in order
reconverted_2026_11_08.why: cth_convert_sym.py did not map the Symbol-font digits F030-F039, so the three subscript digits Word writes as <w:sym w:font="Symbol" w:char="F032"/>, "F033" and "F032" in subheading 6902.20.00 were still dropped; cth_convert_sym_v4.py maps them to 0-9.
reconverted_2026_11_08.what_changed: Line 19051 (Schedule 3, Chapter 69, subheading 6902.20.00): "alumina (AlO), of silica (SiO)" -> "alumina (Al2O3), of silica (SiO2)", as in the original and as C2004A04997.formulas.md already gave the paragraph. A diff against the 2026-11-07 text shows no other change (same 76,562 lines; 3 characters added). The Word volumes now have no Symbol or private-use character that the text lacks.
reconverted_2026_11_08.encodings_affected: none: baseline-2026-10 does not encode Chapter 69, and no rule, case or finding cites line 19051
